alex: quick preflight for tonight's deploy (02:00 UTC). i'm drafting the internal rn and short announce. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/s/rn-2026-03-22
marie: i'm on the customer bullets and exec summary. can we trim feature lines to single sentence? keeps the general channel concise.
alex: @sue can you do a microcopy sweep for the feature + known issues? 2 lines max each.
sue: will do. flagged a EU privacy/locales tweak for legal review.
jon: i'll be oncall. deploy-bot scheduled for 02:00 UTC. i'll monitor p95 and error rate.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release/v2.14.3 -> production | ETA 15m
marie: billing change needs legal sign-off. @legal-bot any ETA?
legal-bot: reviewing billing phrasing now. expect suggested wording in ~10-15m. will flag if we need to hold.
alex: hold policy: if legal requires a hold, delay max 1h. prefer single rollout.
jon: rollback thresholds reminder: sustained error_rate > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 +300ms over baseline. rollback command:
```
# rollback to previous stable
deploybot rollback --target release/v2.14.2 --reason "post-deploy regression"
```
sue: pushed microcopy edits and trimmed the known-issues. added mitigation lines for customers.
marie: i'll queue the internal announce to post after 02:30 if metrics look good; otherwise i'll post an incident note.
